system.description:
When you summon a Creature as a result of a Genjutsu you cast or summon a creature with the Illusory Construct trait, it gains the following benefits, while they remain summoned;

They gain additional Hit points equal to 5 + your level.

The first time they deal damage each turn, increase the damage they deal by +2. This increases to +4 at 11th level.
